secrets.name: LOVABLE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Lovable AI gateway API key — needed for AI features (image generation, story brainstorming). Get it from the Lovable dashboard. The app boots without it but AI features will be disabled.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key for server-side admin operations (bypasses RLS). Get it from the Supabase dashboard → Settings → API. The app boots without it but admin/server-side DB operations will fail.
